80 Students Actioned for Ragging at Barmer Medical College

At Barmer Medical College in Rajasthan, 80 students, including 15 female students, have faced action following allegations of ragging junior students. Thirteen students have been expelled from the hostel. Investigations uncovered WhatsApp chats and objectionable social media content related to the incidents.
